sources.decision_basis: Medstat aggregate statistics have affirmative official reuse terms with attribution, but the public bulk-download page contains supporting metadata rather than utilisation results. Acquisition and retention of exported result payloads require the maintainer's source-specific acceptance.

The historic anonymous NorPD report service permits reuse with source attribution and is frozen with data through 2020. This does not authorize restricted person-level registry access or imply post-2020 coverage.

Socialstyrelsen exposes public aggregate statistics databases and API reuse under CC0 with source attribution guidance. This does not authorize person-level medicines-register data or external publication by this project.
